content.name: Liam Fitzgerald
content.title: Senior Accountant, CPA
content.summary: CPA Australia member with nine years in public practice, mining services and hospitality. Runs the monthly close, BAS and FBT for a 14-venue hospitality group turning over $96 million and recovered $260,000 in overpaid payroll tax after a grouping review.

experience.title: Senior Accountant
bullets: Run the monthly close for 14 pubs and restaurants, delivering venue P&Ls to operations managers by business day four.
Lodge monthly BAS and annual FBT returns, and reconcile GST across Xero and the Lightspeed point-of-sale feeds.
Identified $260,000 in overpaid Queensland payroll tax through a grouping review and lodged the reassessment request.
Supervise one assistant accountant and an accounts payable officer, reviewing reconciliations weekly.

experience.title: Accountant
bullets: Managed project accounting for 22 contracts on Bowen Basin mine sites with combined annual billings of about $48 million.
Introduced weekly work-in-progress reviews with site leads, which reduced unbilled revenue at month end by 35%.
Prepared fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules for 340 items of heavy plant.
Coordinated the year-end audit and statutory accounts under Australian Accounting Standards.

experience.title: Graduate Accountant
bullets: Prepared tax returns and financial statements for 70 small business, trust and SMSF clients.
Migrated 25 clients from MYOB desktop to Xero, including chart of accounts clean-ups.
Prepared quarterly BAS for tradespeople and medical practices, meeting every ATO lodgement deadline.

achievements.title: $260,000 payroll tax recovery
achievements.detail: Grouping review at Riverbend Hospitality Group led to a reassessment request and refund.

achievements.title: Unbilled revenue down 35%
achievements.detail: Weekly WIP reviews at Coalface Mining Services.
